key_idea: Reduce Keller's conjecture in dimension 7 to the absence of 128-cliques in Keller graphs G_{7,s}. Break symmetry by hand using automorphisms and the known dimension-6 case, then settle the remaining thousands of subcases with a SAT solver and a certified RAT clausal proof.
reason: The core of the proof is an enormous machine search verified by a certificate, which gives no human-graspable reason why no faceshare-free tiling exists. The human part (the Keller graph reduction and the extremal symmetry-breaking argument with lambda) is clever bookkeeping, but it only prepares the problem for brute force.
recognized: Brakensiek, Heule, Mackey, Narváez, 'The Resolution of Keller's Conjecture' (IJCAR 2020)
